info.title: Schiphol Airport Universal API
info.description: Access Amsterdam Airport Schiphol public flight information, including flights, airlines, aircraft types, destinations, and flight status data from the Public Flight API.

get.description: Retrieves an airline from Schiphol Airport by IATA or ICAO code.

schema.description: Scheduled date to retrieve flights for, formatted YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: scheduleTime
parameters.description: Scheduled time to retrieve flights from, formatted HH:mm.

schema.description: Scheduled time to retrieve flights from, formatted HH:mm.

parameters.name: flightName
parameters.description: Flight number as printed on the ticket, such as KL1234.

schema.description: Flight number as printed on the ticket, such as KL1234.

parameters.name: flightDirection
parameters.description: Flight direction: A for arrivals or D for departures.

schema.description: Flight direction: A for arrivals or D for departures.

parameters.description: IATA or ICAO airline prefix, such as KL or KLM.

parameters.description: Schiphol numeric airline code.

parameters.name: route
parameters.description: IATA or ICAO route airport code; multiple values can be comma separated.

schema.description: IATA or ICAO route airport code; multiple values can be comma separated.

parameters.name: includedelays
parameters.description: Include earlier scheduled flights delayed into the requested date.

parameters.description: Result page number, starting at 0.
